newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Communist Duma chairman says Yeltsin "in control".
newsitem.headline: Communist Duma chairman says Yeltsin "in control".

text.p: Gennady Seleznyov, the communist speaker of Russia's State Duma lower house of parliament, met Boris Yeltsin on Monday and said later the ailing president did not seem to have relinquished his hold on power.

"Despite his illness, he is in control of the situation and is taking decisions by himself. I think he has information on everything going on in the country," Seleznyov told reporters after the 30-minute meeting with Yeltsin, who is preparing for heart surgery.
Seleznyov met Yeltsin at the Barvikha sanatorium outside Moscow, where the Russian leader is resting before the operation, planned for mid-November.
"It was not a 30-minute monologue by me but a dialogue. Yeltsin spoke without briefing papers and reacted in a lively way during our conversation," said Seleznyov.
The Russian leader, who suffered two heart attacks last year, said on September 5 he would undergo open heart surgery.
The news sparked an increasingly bitter Kremlin power struggle which Yeltsin tried to end last Thursday when he sacked security chief Alexander Lebed.
